Messages.Author: Daniel Figueiredo Silva
Messages.Body:
Hi. This has probably already been asked, but I would just like to be sure.
If
I play Forced Awakening against a bleed action and then redirect, deflect or
otherwise send the bleed away, do I have to pay a bloos as per Forced
Awakening text? How about if I reduce the bleed to zero or less? When
exactly
should I pay the blood cost on Forced Awakening?

Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
--

"Daniel Figueiredo Silva" <om...@MailAndNews.com> wrote in message
news:3AFB...@MailAndNews.com...

> Hi. This has probably already been asked, but I would just like to be
sure.
> If
> I play Forced Awakening against a bleed action and then redirect, deflect
or
> otherwise send the bleed away, do I have to pay a bloos as per Forced
> Awakening text? How about if I reduce the bleed to zero or less? When
> exactly
> should I pay the blood cost on Forced Awakening?

Whenever you don't successfully block you have to burn a blood (if any to
burn). If you reduce or redirect you don't block, so that means you have to
burn a blood.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. And you burn the blood when the action resolves (successfully or blocked by someone else).
